import pandas as pd

# Load source tables with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_6/training_0.csv"
source1_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_6/training_1.csv"

df_source0 = pd.read_csv(source0_path, index_col=0)
df_source1 = pd.read_csv(source1_path, index_col=0)

# Operation 1: JOIN Source2_6_0 and Source2_6_1 on "calaccess_committee_id"
df_joined = pd.merge(
    df_source0,
    df_source1,
    how="inner",
    left_on="calaccess_committee_id",
    right_on="calaccess_committee_id",
    suffixes=('_0', '_1')
)

# Operation 2: group_by on Source2_6_1.committee_name and aggregation sum(Source2_6_1.amount)
# Note: Source2_6_1.committee_name is from df_source1, after merge it is "committee_name_1"
grouped = (
    df_joined
    .groupby("committee_name_1", as_index=False)
    .agg({"amount": "sum"})
)

# Rename columns to match target schema: ['committee_name_x': string, 'amount': float]
grouped.rename(columns={"committee_name_1": "committee_name_x"}, inplace=True)

# Ensure correct dtypes
grouped["committee_name_x"] = grouped["committee_name_x"].astype(str)
grouped["amount"] = grouped["amount"].astype(float)

# Write the result to the target path
target_path = "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_6/target_multisource.csv"
grouped.to_csv(target_path, index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_6/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_6/training_1.csv", index_col=0)

# Join Source2_6_0 and Source2_6_1 on calaccess_committee_id
joined = pd.merge(
    source0,
    source1,
    how="inner",
    left_on="calaccess_committee_id",
    right_on="calaccess_committee_id",
    suffixes=('_x', '')
)

# Select committee_name from Source2_6_0 as committee_name_x to match target schema
joined = joined.rename(columns={"committee_name_x": "committee_name_x"})
joined["committee_name_x"] = joined["committee_name_x"].fillna(joined["committee_name"])

# The target schema has committee_name_x and amount
# Use committee_name_x from Source2_6_0 (renamed) and amount from Source2_6_1

# Because after join, committee_name_x may not exist, we create it from source0.committee_name
joined["committee_name_x"] = joined["committee_name_x"].combine_first(joined["committee_name"])

# Group by committee_name_x and sum amount
result = joined.groupby("committee_name_x", as_index=False).agg({"amount": "sum"})

# Write output with exact target schema and column names
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length2_6/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
